_note: Why each UC-Davis-only AVA is not in TTB's list (spec §5.4), and what each TTB-only AVA lacks. Researched in-session on 2026-09-29; each entry names its source. usa-ava-diff.mjs reads ucd_only only; ttb_only and matched_notes are information for US-1 and US-5.

ttb_only.Beverly, Washington: 27 CFR 9.297, established 2024-10-29. UC Davis has it as its own file (avas/beverly_washington.geojson, 8,242 B at 355f7da), but the per-state file avas_by_state/WA_avas.geojson at the same commit does not include it. US-5 can take it from that per-AVA file (not downloaded in US-0) or from TTB's AVA Map Explorer.
ttb_only.Columbia Hills: 27 CFR 9.301, established 2026-08-17 (TTB list updated 2026-08-18). No UC Davis file at 355f7da (avas/ has no columbia_hills), as the spec found. US-5 takes it from TTB's AVA Map Explorer.

matched_notes.comptche: UC Davis carries no cfr_index for Comptche; it matched TTB's Comptche (27 CFR 9.292) by name alone.
matched_notes.crystal_springs_of_napa_valley: UC Davis's name has a trailing space ("Crystal Springs of Napa Valley "); the tree uses TTB's legal name.
matched_notes.mount_pisgah__polk_county__oregon: 27 CFR 9.284's heading is "Mount Pisgah, Polk County, Oregon" (as UC Davis spells it); TTB's list page writes "Mt. Pisgah, Polk County, Oregon". The legal name (the CFR heading) is used.
